text: Putting an AI agent to work still feels like trial and error.
Work goes missing, and nobody can show what was done.
Agent Company gives the work a line, with six stations.
First a project. Then a team, with one job each.
Then the harness: six limits, fitted with one click.
Nothing skips ahead. A station opens only when the one before it is done.
Written orders go in, and one coordinator starts the line.
The screen shows only what is really in your repo.
Then the proof is sealed. Merging stays with you.
